column1: #   id  severity(block|warn)  targets(msg,add,comment,path,ident)  flags(- | strict | strictblock)  ERE
# Lines are lowercased before matching, so patterns are lowercase POSIX ERE.
# Word boundaries are spelled (^|[^[:alnum:]_])word([^[:alnum:]_]|$); never \b or \<.
# flags: strict = row only applies in strict mode; strictblock = warn normally, block in strict mode.
# @hexref is special: a 7-40 char hex word that resolves to a commit in this repo.
# comment-wall is built in (scan.awk): more than rules.maxCommentLines consecutive added comment lines
# (default 3, or 1 in strict mode; 0 turns it off) is a warning, or a block in strict mode.

column5: (^|[^[:alnum:]_])(as requested|as you (asked|requested)|it'?s worth noting|it is worth noting|for clarity|as mentioned (above|earlier|before))([^[:alnum:]_]|$)
